summary: The Streaming Platform Engineer builds, manages, and optimizes event-driven streaming platforms to support real-time analytics and applications.
responsibilities: Design and deploy streaming data platforms
Integrate multiple streaming technologies and data sources
Ensure scalability, reliability, and fault tolerance
Optimize cluster resources and streaming performance
Collaborate with data engineers, analysts, and DevOps teams

education: 4–7 years of experience in streaming platform engineering

skills_required.name: Expertise in Kafka, Flink, or Spark Streaming
Knowledge of cloud-based streaming services (AWS Kinesis, Azure Event Hubs,
Familiarity with monitoring and alerting tools
